name: Repeated round-value transactions
description: Transactions are repeatedly in round or unusually uniform amounts that do not fit the stated purpose.
fp: Rents, salaries, loan instalments and fees are commonly round amounts.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)

Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Prepaid Cards, Mobile Payments and Internet-Based Payment Services (2013)
Card scheme rules on merchant and payment facilitator monitoring (general reference)

links.name: Repeated round-value transactions
links.ctx: Frequent round-sum amounts without related invoices or obligations.
links.fp: Rent, salaries and gifts often use round numbers.

links.name: Unusual ticket sizes or round amounts
links.ctx: Average ticket differs sharply from the merchant category or is repetitive and rounded.
